node.title: Rank-eleven rich-flat residual mass compiler
node.closure: quantitative nontransverse mass, row-space population, and canonical rich-container partition
node.statement: Every unsafe KoalaBear post-near affine-error-rank-eleven line leaves at least 2007222636725 selected slopes in non-42452-transverse rank-one/rank-two row-space groups. There are at least 8106 distinct such represented row spaces. Canonically extend each rich proper annihilator flat to a hyperplane and merge groups with the same promoted space W. This partitions the residual into distinct dimension-two/three affine containers satisfying R2*B2+R3*B3>=2007222636725, where R2=247628052 and R3=3953204973; hence B2+B3>=508. Every container has at least 42453 common actual zero coordinates inside the anchor-good set, all of its pair types agree with the received pair there, and the common-core adapter shortens that bucket exactly. No locator synchronization or cross-bucket chronology owner is claimed.
